name: What Happens to Your Baseboards During a Sammamish Refinish
title-tag: What Happens to Baseboards in a Refinish? Sammamish Guide
meta-description: Baseboards stay on the wall during a hardwood refinish — here’s how edgers sand that close, what happens to quarter-round, and the honest cosmetic fine print.
post-summary: November 30, 2026 · Baseboards stay on the wall during a refinish — the edger sands to their face and finish stops cleanly at the trim. What actually happens to quarter-round, why a hairline of unpainted baseboard can appear afterward, and why Sammamish’s tall MDF trim is the best case for leaving everything in place.
